message.content:
This editorial illustration features a caricature of a man from the chest up against a blue background. The man has tan skin, a large bald head, and a furrowed brow. His eyes are squinted, and his mouth is open in an oval shape, emitting several white liquid droplets. He wears a dark suit, white shirt, and red necktie. A gold-colored emblem is pinned to his lapel. His right arm is raised with a clenched fist. Emerging from a small dark opening near the center of his chest is a tiny figure wearing a black balaclava, holding a finger to its mouth in a "shush" gesture.

Large, black text reading "TEMPO" spans the top background. Above this, white text on a red and blue border reads "Kekerasan Aparat Makin Meruyak H.84" and "Sandera Impor Suku Cadang Maskapai H.90". On the left, white text states "BOBOL LAGI BERKALI-KALI" followed by four lines of smaller Indonesian text ending with "H.28". The bottom right corner contains a date, price, website, and barcode.
